library.description: Native RDF and SPARQL protocol storage backend

blocks.text: 在 `createStorageHost` 中安装 `sparqlBackendPlugin({ endpoint }, features?)`。缺省 id 为 `sparql`，显式 `id` 在 `host.backend(id)` 中保持精确类型；`sparqlBackendKind` 校验 Feature。后端提供共享 `rdf`、`sparql` 与原生乐观事务，不提供 KV、record、vector、SQL 或键锁。
endpoint 与 Oxigraph Store 均由调用方创建并拥有，后端不关闭它们。`dispose()` 返回缓存的主 Promise，失败时拒绝；`Symbol.asyncDispose` 返回另一个缓存的派生 Promise，只上报失败并成功，两者共用清理。关闭拒绝新调用、取消活动读取，并等待已发送提交结束。

公开入口为根、`/http` 的 `httpEndpoint`、`/oxigraph` 的 `oxigraphEndpoint`、`/features/graph-store` 的 `graphStoreFeature`、`/features/ontology` 的 `ontologyFeature`。根不加载 Oxigraph 原生运行代码。安装真实 peer `@migaia/storage-host`、`n3`、`oxigraph`；已验证原生版本为 n3 1.26.0 与 Oxigraph 0.4.11，RDF/JS 声明来自真实依赖，不使用替代 Store 类型或 optional peer 降级。

标准 RDF 仅接受 ground quad：主语/谓语为命名节点，宾语为命名节点或字面量，图为缺省图或命名图。语言、datatype、转义与规范身份归共享契约。raw SELECT/CONSTRUCT 和 ontology 文档另支持 blank；blank 标识局限于同一响应/文档，跨次导入不会混同。RDF-star、文档变量与标准 blank quad 拒绝，这是明确的 ground RDF 边界；推理由数据库承担。

`ERROR_SOURCE` 为 `storage.backend.sparql`。`SPARQL_REQUEST_FAILED` 保留原生 HTTP 明确拒绝的 status/body/cause；`SPARQL_UNAVAILABLE` 表示读取 transport/5xx 失败；`SPARQL_RESPONSE_INVALID` 表示结果或文档非法；`SPARQL_COMMIT_UNKNOWN` 表示已发送写缺少确认，不自动重放，当前后端后续写入拒绝。先核实原生 dataset，再创建新后端。本地非法输入与能力不支持沿原共享错误族。原生错误类型、原 cause/stack 可达，认证头与配置不进入错误数据或 hooks。
HTTP 部署要求、事务、查询写入、Graph Store、ontology、成本与 marker 清理见 USEGUIDE.md。
事务 callback、draft 或 finalizer 的业务失败使用 `TRANSACTION_FAILED`，保留原生类型与原 primary，不冒充端点不可用；已有 contract 与原生协议错误保持原身份。
未设置 `expect` 时，仅保证规范 quad 的集合成员操作；并发读取旧值后分别写入不同宾语，两个新 quad 可以同时保留，不提供谓词单值的后写覆盖。需要检测这类竞争时，使用 `expect` 校验读到的 quad。
安装代码见 README.md。配置工厂同步且无 I/O；宿主拥有安装、检测、pipeline 与释放。`autoDetect: false` 时必须先显式 `await host.detect()`，未检测的真实终点在业务 I/O 前拒绝，不会隐式发起检测。
URL 必须为无内嵌凭据的绝对 HTTP(S) URL。可选 auth 在 Basic 与 Bearer 中精确选一；仅需要 Graph Store/ontology 时提供 graphStoreUrl。URL API 对图参数编码一次。修改请求仅发送一次，不跟随重定向；读取沿原 fetch 行为。HEAD404 返回 false，GET404 拒绝，认证与 raw 正文不进入埋点。

部署必须保证同一 dataset 上单条条件 Modify 原子执行、随后读取可见；HTTP 协议本身不能证明此保证。实际验收为 Apache Jena Fuseki 6.2.0 与 Oxigraph 0.4.11，其他部署须做同一原生验收。`httpEndpoint` 不提供 atomicUpdate；`oxigraphEndpoint(new Store())` 提供真实单次 Store.update，不把多个 HTTP 请求当成交互事务。

sections.heading: Ground RDF 与统一查询链

blocks.text: `store.use(rdf).add/delete` 只收 ground quad，语言、datatype、图与转义保持共享规范。`match(pattern)` 使用原不可变查询链，支持 where、follow/inverse、orderBy、distinct、skip、limit、分页、聚合终点与 stream。原生 SELECT 供给 ground 匹配，客户端剩余工作归共享执行器，explain 如实描述；requirePushdown 对不支持的客户端步骤在 I/O 前拒绝。

blocks.code:
const selected = store
  .use(rdf)
  .match({ predicate: quad.predicate })
  .where((q) => q.object.value === 'Alice')
console.log(selected.explain())
const removed = await selected.delete()
const replaced = await store
  .use(rdf)
  .match({})
  .replace(quad, { ...quad, object: term.literal('Ada') })

blocks.text: 删除按实际选择并接受的规范 quad 去重计数；replace 仅替换选中的 old quad，未选中返回 0。根调用等原生提交确认才返回计数；事务内计数描述草稿。筛选和 traversal 不绕过共享链。
每个组织的逻辑 default/named 图映射到 `urn:migaia:org:<orgId>:` 前缀下的真实命名图，根与借用组织视图同样隔离。非配置缺省组织禁止 raw SPARQL。`host.dropOrg(id)` 删除其全部真实图，包括 blank 文档与空命名图，不影响其他组织。

blocks.code:
import { ConcurrencyPolicy } from '@migaia/storage-host/authoring/concurrency'
await store
  .tx()
  .concurrency(ConcurrencyPolicy.optimistic({ retries: 1 }))
  .run(async (scope) => {
    scope.use(rdf).expect([quad])
    scope.use(rdf).expectAbsent([{ ...quad, object: term.literal('new') }])
    await scope.use(rdf).delete([quad])
    await scope.use(rdf).add([{ ...quad, object: term.literal('new') }])
    console.log(await scope.use(rdf).match({}).count())
  })

blocks.text: scope 仅提供带 expect/expectAbsent 的 native RDF 与 update-only raw tag，不提供 KV、lock 或 wait/fail 策略。原 transaction owner 管理 accepted work、首错、iterator、finalizer 与过期 scope；不另建生命周期。草稿按规范身份去重，最后操作覆盖前操作。present 条件按合取，每个 absent 独立 NOT EXISTS。

一次条件 DELETE/INSERT WHERE 原子写用户 quad 与 `urn:migaia:commit` 中随机 marker；一次 ASK 确认，再单独清理 marker。只有 Update 成功且 ASK 成功并明确 marker 不存在才是可沿原 optimistic policy 重试的冲突。Update 已发送但结果未知、ASK 失败/取消均为 SPARQL_COMMIT_UNKNOWN，停止当前安装后端后续写入，不重放；先检查原生数据库再创建新后端。清理 marker 失败只上报，用户数据已经提交。没有写前提时仍按规范 quad 的集合身份执行 add/delete：同一 quad 的最后成员操作生效，但并发事务写入不同宾语可同时保留两条 quad，不提供谓词单值覆盖，也不自动校验读集。需要此类竞争保护时，使用 `expect`。

有真实 atomicUpdate 的端点才可在事务内执行一个 `scope.use(sparql)\`INSERT DATA { ... }\`.update()` body，不能混任何 RDF 操作/前提或第二个 raw body。通用 HTTP 在写入前拒绝此能力。根 raw tag 支持 select/ask/construct/update，值绑定归共享编译器；普通字符串不是 SPARQL 语法，不得作为语法插入。
标准 RDF、Graph Store、ontology 禁止保留 marker 图。进程崩溃可能遗留 marker；管理员先确认活动提交后，可直接在数据库执行 `CLEAR SILENT GRAPH <urn:migaia:commit>`。直接 native/raw 管理操作修改该图不在标准条件提交保证范围。

安装时选择 graphStoreFeature()/ontologyFeature()。前者五方法为 getGraph、putGraph、mergeGraph、removeGraph、hasGraph；后者为 importOntology、exportOntology，均只在根 store.api，事务投影为空，不存在 prepare 或 transaction client。target 精确为 `{default:true}` 或 `{graph:namedNode}`，末参为原 ctx。get/export 缺省 Turtle，文档显式 Turtle 或 N-Triples。
ontology 缺省 merge，replace 沿真实 per-graph replace。返回解析条数（含重复），不是新增条数。相同文档内 blank 共享保持，每次导入新 blank 前缀，跨文档独立。N3 负责 RDF1.1 parser/writer，RDF-star 拒绝；推理及供应商规则由数据库管理。

store 操作及 Feature 终点均经原 async pipeline。存储 hooks、beforeSparqlUpdate、onPreconditionFailed、onHttpRequest 只观察，抛错/拒绝只 report，不能中止或改写；干预写 pipeline stage。更新事件只有操作/前提数量，HTTP 只有脱敏 route、method、可选 status 与耗时，无认证或正文。
错误域与四类原生错误见 README。读写成本按实际 RDF 字节；草稿预期 O(q)，条件文本 O(q+p) 加实际 quad 字节，native match 读取实际结果后沿共享客户端预算执行，文档 O(字节+quad) 并完整传输。不含数据库计划、网络与推理成本，不增加第二套时钟、重试器或执行平台。
原事务 callback、已接受 draft 任务或 finalizer 的业务失败使用 `TRANSACTION_FAILED`，原失败仍为 primary，原生类型与 stack 保留。原生读取在读取边界归族，因此事务内 transport 失败仍为 `SPARQL_UNAVAILABLE`；已有 contract/协议错误不改身份。

Install `sparqlBackendPlugin({ endpoint }, features?)` in `createStorageHost`. The default id is `sparql`; an explicit `id` stays exact in `host.backend(id)`. `sparqlBackendKind` authenticates Features. The backend exposes the shared `rdf` and `sparql` capabilities, native optimistic transactions, and no KV, records, vector, SQL or key-lock API.

The caller creates and owns the endpoint and any Oxigraph Store. Disposal never closes them. `dispose()` returns one cached rejecting main Promise; `Symbol.asyncDispose` returns one cached reporting Promise and shares the cleanup. Closing rejects new calls, cancels active reads and drains already-sent commits.

Public entries are the module root, `/http` (`httpEndpoint`), `/oxigraph` (`oxigraphEndpoint`), `/features/graph-store` (`graphStoreFeature`) and `/features/ontology` (`ontologyFeature`). The root does not load the native Oxigraph runtime. Install the real peers `@migaia/storage-host`, `n3` and `oxigraph`; tested native peers are n3 1.26.0 and Oxigraph 0.4.11. RDF/JS declarations are real dependencies; no substitute Store type or optional-peer fallback is used.

Standard RDF accepts ground named subjects/predicates, named or literal objects, and default/named graphs. Language, datatype, escaping and canonical quad identity use the shared contract. Raw SELECT/CONSTRUCT and ontology documents also support blank nodes. Blank identifiers are local to one response/document; separate imports remain distinct. RDF-star, variables in documents, and blank standard quads reject. This is an intentional ground RDF boundary, not a full OWL reasoning engine.

`ERROR_SOURCE` is `storage.backend.sparql`. `SPARQL_REQUEST_FAILED` retains explicit native HTTP refusal status/body/cause. `SPARQL_UNAVAILABLE` reports read transport/5xx failures. `SPARQL_RESPONSE_INVALID` reports invalid results/documents. `SPARQL_COMMIT_UNKNOWN` means a sent write lacks confirmation: it is not replayed, and later writes on this installed backend reject. Inspect the native dataset, then create a new backend. Local invalid input and unsupported capabilities use the original shared error family. Native error types and original causes/stacks remain reachable; authentication headers/configuration are not copied into hooks or error data.
See USEGUIDE.en.md for HTTP deployment requirements, transactions, query writes, Graph Store, ontology, costs and marker cleanup.

Transaction callback, draft or finalizer business failures use `TRANSACTION_FAILED`, preserving the original native type and primary cause; they do not report endpoint unavailability. Existing contract and native protocol errors retain their identities.

Without `expect`, writes retain canonical quad set semantics. Concurrent read-modify-write transactions inserting different objects can retain both new quads; predicate values do not have a last-writer guarantee. Use `expect` to validate the quads read before changing them.

Use the installation example in README.en.md. All configuration factories are synchronous and perform no I/O; the host owns installation, detection, pipelines and disposal. With `autoDetect: false`, call `await host.detect()` explicitly before any endpoint operation. An undetected endpoint rejects before business I/O without running detection implicitly.

Use absolute HTTP(S) URLs without embedded credentials. `auth` is exactly Basic `{ basic: { user, password } }` or Bearer `{ bearer }`, and is optional. `graphStoreUrl` is optional unless Graph Store or ontology is selected. URL API encodes each graph query value once. Mutation redirects are not followed; requests are sent once. HEAD404 returns false; GET404 rejects. Reads may follow native fetch redirects. Do not put credentials or raw query text in telemetry.

A supported deployment must atomically execute one conditional SPARQL 1.1 Modify and provide read-after-write visibility on the same dataset. The protocol alone cannot certify that guarantee. Actual validation covers Apache Jena Fuseki 6.2.0 and Oxigraph 0.4.11; other deployments require the same native checks. `httpEndpoint` supplies no `atomicUpdate`; `oxigraphEndpoint(new Store())` supplies one genuine native Store.update. Never infer interactive transactions from multiple HTTP requests.

sections.heading: Ground RDF and shared query chains

blocks.text: `match` uses the original shared immutable query chain: where, traversal `follow`/`inverse`, orderBy, distinct, skip, limit, pages, scalar terminals and streaming. Native SELECT supplies ground matches; remaining operators use the shared executor. `requirePushdown()` rejects unsupported client operators before native I/O. `delete()` counts canonical selected quads accepted by the draft; `replace(old,new)` changes only a selected old quad and returns 0 if it was not selected. Root counts settle only after native commit confirmation; transaction counts describe the current draft. No query mutation bypasses its filters or creates another executor.

Each organization maps logical default/named graphs into its own named graph prefix `urn:migaia:org:<orgId>:`. Root and borrowed organization views use the same mapping. Raw SPARQL is available only in the configured default organization. `host.dropOrg(id)` removes all its physical graphs, including blank-node documents and empty named graphs; it does not drop other organizations.

blocks.code:
await store
  .tx()
  .concurrency(ConcurrencyPolicy.optimistic({ retries: 1 }))
  .run(async (scope) => {
    scope.use(rdf).expect([quad])
    scope.use(rdf).expectAbsent([{ ...quad, object: term.literal('new') }])
    await scope.use(rdf).delete([quad])
    await scope.use(rdf).add([{ ...quad, object: term.literal('new') }])
    console.log(await scope.use(rdf).match({}).count())
  })

blocks.text: Import `ConcurrencyPolicy` from `@migaia/storage-contract`. The scope retains only native RDF with `expect`/`expectAbsent` and an update-only raw tag; no KV or lock methods exist. The original transaction owner handles accepted work, first failure, iterators, finalizers and expired scopes. The draft deduplicates canonical quads with last-operation-wins. Preconditions are conjunctions; each absent quad gets an independent NOT EXISTS.

One conditional DELETE/INSERT WHERE writes user data and a random commit marker in `urn:migaia:commit`. One ASK confirms it, then a separate cleanup removes the marker. Only a successful Update plus a successful false ASK is a confirmed conflict eligible for the original optimistic retry policy. An ASK failure or unknown sent Update seals further writes with `SPARQL_COMMIT_UNKNOWN`, without replay. Cleanup failure only reports because user data already committed. Without preconditions, add/delete use canonical quad set identity: the final membership operation for the same quad wins, but concurrent transactions inserting different objects can retain both quads. Predicate values have no last-writer guarantee and the read set is not checked automatically; use `expect` for that protection.

On an actual `atomicUpdate` endpoint, a transaction may instead contain exactly one `scope.use(sparql)\`INSERT DATA { ... }\`.update()`body. It cannot mix any RDF operations/preconditions or a second raw body; generic HTTP rejects this authority before writing. Root raw`select/ask/construct/update` tags use shared value binding and do not expose endpoint fields. Never interpolate SPARQL grammar as an ordinary value; use the original trusted fragment helpers where grammar is intentional.

The marker graph is reserved in standard RDF, Graph Store and ontology. A crashed process may leave markers. After inspecting active operations, an administrator may run `CLEAR SILENT GRAPH <urn:migaia:commit>` directly against the native database. Raw administrative access or direct native mutation of the reserved graph is outside standard conditional-commit guarantees.

Select `graphStoreFeature()` and/or `ontologyFeature()` during installation. Both expose root-only `store.api` methods and empty transaction projections. Targets are exactly `{ default: true }` or `{ graph: namedNode }`. Every method accepts the original operation context as its last argument. Get/export default to Turtle; documents require explicit Turtle or N-Triples format. Missing native graph ports reject in host detection; there is no Feature prepare or transaction client.

Ontology import defaults to merge; replace uses one native per-graph replace. Its count is parsed quads, including duplicates, not newly inserted rows. N3 parser/writer preserve RDF 1.1 literals and blank sharing within a document, assign a fresh prefix per import, and reject RDF-star. Inference and supplier-specific rule configuration stay with the native database.

Operations and Feature leaves enter the original async pipeline. Storage hooks and `beforeSparqlUpdate`, `onPreconditionFailed`, `onHttpRequest` only observe; throwing/rejecting observers report and cannot cancel or rewrite operations. The update hook exposes operation/precondition counts; HTTP events expose sanitized route, method, optional status and elapsed time, never authentication or bodies. Use pipeline stages for intervention.

Point work is proportional to actual quad bytes. Draft accumulation and deduplication are expected O(q); conditional text is O(q + p) plus RDF bytes. Match fetches its native result and shared client operators follow their original query budgets; documents cost O(bytes + parsed quads) and transfer the whole document. These costs exclude database planning, network latency and inference. No second retry, clock, resource or query platform is installed.

A business failure in the original transaction callback, accepted draft task or finalizer uses `TRANSACTION_FAILED`. The original failure remains primary and its native type/stack survives. Native read failures are classified at the native read boundary, so a transport failure inside a transaction still uses `SPARQL_UNAVAILABLE`; existing contract/protocol failures are not relabelled.

members.name: signal
members.description: Requests cooperative cancellation. Backends can ignore work cancellation, while cancellation-aware operations stop waiting with the contract `ABORTED` error. Uses a structural signal without depending on the global `AbortSignal`.

members.name: timeoutMs
members.description: Optional non-negative safe-integer timeout in milliseconds. The backend creates any timer or combined signal it needs; this contract package creates neither. Omission leaves timing to the implementation rather than supplying a default duration.

members.name: pageSize
members.description: Optional iterator page-size hint: an integer from 1 through 4096. No default is inserted here.

members.name: orgId
members.description: Optional canonical lowercase UUID supplied by an outer host. The contract preserves omission; the host chooses the default organization and owns namespace mapping.
